map_generation_note: CODEBASE-MAP.md's §14 documentation index renders the map's own line/byte size, so a single `gen-codebase-map.mjs` run always trails the file it just wrote. Run it twice (or to a passing `--check`) after any file-count change. At 911234c the first pass had left a deleted file (DESIGN.md) listed and the Markdown census at 165/13 instead of 164/12. Second hazard: §14 records the line count of every tracked `.md`, so editing any Markdown file — including this artifact set — invalidates the map again. Finish all Markdown edits first, then run the generator last, to convergence.
